# Make it obvious what functions do

## Make it obvious what functions do {transition="slide-in fade-out"}

```{r}
#| code-line-numbers: 1-10|1-1
my_fun <- function(x, y, z) {
  y2 <- ceiling(y * z * 100) / 100
  y3 <- y + y2
  data.frame(
    item = x,
    price = y,
    sales_tax = y2,
    total_price = y3
  )
}
```

## Make it obvious what functions do {transition="fade-in fade-out"}

```{r}
#| code-line-numbers: 1-1
compile_order_df <- function(x, y, z) {
  y2 <- ceiling(y * z * 100) / 100
  y3 <- y + y2
  data.frame(
    item = x,
    price = y,
    sales_tax = y2,
    total_price = y3
  )
}
```

## Make it obvious what functions do {transition="fade-in fade-out"}

```{r}

  total_price <- prices + sales_tax
  data.frame(
    item = items,
    price = prices,
    sales_tax = sales_tax,
    total_price = total_price

}
```

```{r}

  total_price <- prices + sales_tax
  data.frame(

    total_price = total_price

}
```

## Forgive "close enough" input {transition="slide-in fade-out"}

```{r}
#| code-line-numbers: 1-10|2-2|2-3
compile_order_df <- function(items, prices, tax_rate = 0.0825) {
  sales_tax <- ceiling(prices * tax_rate * 100) / 100
  total_price <- prices + sales_tax
  data.frame(
    item = items,
    price = prices,
    sales_tax = sales_tax,
    total_price = total_price
  )
}
```

## Forgive "close enough" input {transition="fade-in fade-out"}

```{r}
#| code-line-numbers: 2-2
compile_order_df <- function(items, prices, tax_rate = 0.0825) {
  prices <- stbl::to_dbl(prices)
  sales_tax <- ceiling(prices * tax_rate * 100) / 100
  total_price <- prices + sales_tax
  data.frame(
    item = items,
    price = prices,
    sales_tax = sales_tax,
    total_price = total_price
  )
}
```

## Forgive "close enough" input {transition="fade-in slide-out"}

```{r}
#| code-line-numbers: 2-4
#| eval: true
compile_order_df <- function(items, prices, tax_rate = 0.0825) {
  prices <- stbl::to_dbl(prices)
  tax_rate <- stbl::to_dbl_scalar(tax_rate)
  items <- stbl::to_chr(items)
  sales_tax <- ceiling(prices * tax_rate * 100) / 100
  total_price <- prices + sales_tax
  data.frame(
    item = items,
    price = prices,
    sales_tax = sales_tax,
    total_price = total_price
  )
}
```

## Forgive "close enough" input {transition="slide-in fade-out"}

```{r}
#| code-line-numbers: 3-3
compile_order_df(
  c("paper towels", "toilet paper"),
  c("12.33", "20.77")
)
```

```{r}
#| code-line-numbers: 3-3
```

## {transition="slide-in fade-out"}

```{r}
#| code-line-numbers: 2-4
compile_order_df <- function(items, prices, tax_rate = 0.0825) {
  prices <- stbl::to_dbl(prices)
  tax_rate <- stbl::to_dbl_scalar(tax_rate)
  items <- stbl::to_chr(items)
  sales_tax <- ceiling(prices * tax_rate * 100) / 100
  total_price <- prices + sales_tax
  data.frame(
    item = items,
    price = prices,
    sales_tax = sales_tax,
    total_price = total_price
  )
}
```

## {transition="fade-in slide-out"}

```{r}
#| code-line-numbers: 2-4
#| eval: true
compile_order_df <- function(items, prices, tax_rate = 0.0825) {
  prices <- as.double(prices)
  tax_rate <- as.double(tax_rate)
  items <- as.character(items)
  sales_tax <- ceiling(prices * tax_rate * 100) / 100
  total_price <- prices + sales_tax
  data.frame(
    item = items,
    price = prices,
    sales_tax = sales_tax,
    total_price = total_price
  )
}
```

## {transition="slide-in fade-out"}

```{r}
#| code-line-numbers: 3-3
#| eval: true
compile_order_df(
  c("paper towels", "toilet paper"),
  c("12.33", "20.77")
)
```

## {transition="fade-in fade-out"}

```{r}
#| code-line-numbers: 3-3
compile_order_df(
  c("paper towels", "toilet paper"),
  c("12.33", "b")
)
```

## {transition="fade-in slide-out"}

```{r}
#| code-line-numbers: 3-3
#| eval: true
#| warning: true
compile_order_df(
  c("paper towels", "toilet paper"),
  c("12.33", "b")
)
```

# Tell users how to fix mistakes

## Tell users how to fix mistakes

```{r}
#| code-line-numbers: 2-4
#| eval: true
compile_order_df <- function(items, prices, tax_rate = 0.0825) {
  prices <- stbl::to_dbl(prices)
  tax_rate <- stbl::to_dbl_scalar(tax_rate)
  items <- stbl::to_chr(items)
  sales_tax <- ceiling(prices * tax_rate * 100) / 100
  total_price <- prices + sales_tax
  data.frame(
    item = items,
    price = prices,
    sales_tax = sales_tax,
    total_price = total_price
  )
}
```

## Tell users how to fix mistakes {transition="slide-in fade-out"}

```{r}
#| code-line-numbers: 3-3
compile_order_df(
  c("paper towels", "toilet paper"),
  c("12.33", "b")
)
```

## Tell users how to fix mistakes {transition="fade-in slide-out"}

```{r}
#| code-line-numbers: 3-3
#| eval: true
#| error: true
compile_order_df(
  c("paper towels", "toilet paper"),
  c("12.33", "b")
)
```

## Tell users how to fix mistakes

```{r}
#| eval: true
#| error: true
#| echo: false
cli::cli_abort(c(
  "!" = "{.arg prices} <character> must be coercible to <double>",
  x = "Can't convert some values due to incompatible values.",
  "*" = "Locations: 2",
  "*" = "Values: \"b\"",
  i = "Repair or remove these values and try again."
))
```
